workflow_lab_results_inbox.name: 1. Aviva Lab Results Inbox Workflow
workflow_lab_results_inbox.description: Deterministic DAG that processes incoming lab report emails, extracts data from attached PDFs using Gemini 3.6 Flash Vision, evaluates guardrails using Kimi K3, updates the master Excel tracker via Microsoft Graph API, archives files to OneDrive, and dispatches run summaries.
workflow_lab_results_inbox.verdict: Keep as Deterministic Workflow. Fixed code paths, zero-error guard checks, and exact string matching guarantee 100% precision. Agentic reasoning adds failure mode without value.

steps.name: Fetch Lab Emails (M365 API)
steps.desc: Connects to Outlook API, retrieves unread lab result emails.
steps.routing_rationale: Tool execution & API polling requires sub-second latency (243 tok/s). Gemini Flash eliminates latency overhead.

steps.name: Fetch Excel Tracker State
steps.desc: Reads current lot status and history from master SharePoint Excel file.
steps.routing_rationale: Structured tabular data reading requires fast JSON parsing without premium reasoning costs.

steps.name: OCR & Analytical Data Extraction
steps.desc: Parses attached PDF lab report using native vision to extract exact metric values.
steps.routing_rationale: Requires native Multimodal Vision capabilities to process unstructured PDF lab scans.

steps.name: Evaluate Compliance & Guardrails
steps.desc: Applies Micro vs Analytical classification, human-lock checks, and NA validation.
steps.routing_rationale: Strict compliance & threshold math requires SOTA accuracy (#1 TAU Banking score: 0.3340).

steps.name: Update Excel Cells
steps.desc: Writes color-coded status back to Excel cells via Microsoft Graph API.
steps.routing_rationale: Deterministic API payload construction.

steps.name: Save Attachments to OneDrive
steps.desc: Archives source PDF into organized SharePoint audit folders.
steps.routing_rationale: Deterministic tool execution.

steps.name: Send Run Summary Email
steps.desc: Sends execution summary email to lab operations lead.
steps.routing_rationale: Template email rendering and sending.

workflow_daily_dashboard.name: 2. Aviva Daily Summary Dashboard
workflow_daily_dashboard.description: Hybrid Workflow + Agent pipeline running once daily. Reads master Excel tracker state, categorizes items into 5 operational buckets, compiles contextual recommendations via Claude, and renders Outlook-safe HTML emails.
workflow_daily_dashboard.verdict: Hybrid Workflow + Agent. Data fetching and 5x categorization remain rule-based code paths. Insight generation routes to Claude Sonnet for deep contextual reasoning.

steps.name: Fetch Full Tracker Snapshot
steps.desc: Reads all rows from master lab tracker Excel sheet.
steps.routing_rationale: High context window (1M+) at low cost for reading daily tabular state.

steps.name: 5x Categorization Branching
steps.desc: Groups items into: Overdue, Pending Review, Failed, Passed, Human Locked.
steps.routing_rationale: Fast parallel classification across structured rules.

steps.name: Compile Operational Insights
steps.desc: Synthesizes vendor delay patterns, failure spikes, and actionable next steps.
steps.routing_rationale: High-level executive reasoning and clear prose synthesis.

steps.name: Render Outlook-Safe HTML
steps.desc: Packs findings into locked inline-styled HTML templates compatible with Word desktop engine.
steps.routing_rationale: Strict HTML template generation without hallucinated formatting.

steps.name: Dispatch Daily Briefing Email
steps.desc: Sends email to executive distribution list.
steps.routing_rationale: Deterministic M365 email dispatch.

workflow_repeat_lot_detection.name: 3. Aviva UC3: Repeat Lot Detection (Agentic)
workflow_repeat_lot_detection.description: Persistent Agentic Loop. Tracks lot testing history over 6-month windows. Automatically waives redundant tests for trusted vendor lots or mandates full re-tests if a prior lot failed.
workflow_repeat_lot_detection.verdict: Requires Persistent Agent. Workflows are point-in-time and cannot reason across months of past runs. Claude Haiku maintains state & temporal window awareness.

steps.name: Historical Lot Memory Search
steps.desc: Searches vector store for same vendor lot numbers within last 180 days.
steps.routing_rationale: Temporal reasoning ('160 days = within 6 months window') and semantic search.

steps.name: Waiver Eligibility Reasoning
steps.desc: Evaluates material category, vendor rating, and prior test results.
steps.routing_rationale: Contextual decision branching on waiver rules vs risk score.

steps.name: Execute Waiver / Retest Order
steps.desc: Updates lab instruction queue and registers waiver reason in audit log.
steps.routing_rationale: Deterministic write to database.

steps.name: Notify QA Lead
steps.desc: Dispatches instant alert if a repeat lot fail is detected.
steps.routing_rationale: Notification dispatch.

workflow_two_lab_confirmation.name: 4. Aviva UC4: Two-Lab Confirmation (Agentic)
workflow_two_lab_confirmation.description: Multi-Step Asynchronous Agent. When Lab A fails a sample, agent holds lot in 'Awaiting Confirmation' state, matches incoming Lab B report days later, and executes hard rejection if both fail.
workflow_two_lab_confirmation.verdict: Requires Persistent Agent. Workflows cannot 'wait' days or correlate separate incoming emails across time. Agent state spans across runs.

steps.name: Initial Failure State Hold
steps.desc: Flags Lab A failure and initiates 2nd lab verification order.
steps.routing_rationale: Asynchronous state machine registration.

steps.name: Cross-Email Correlation Engine
steps.desc: Matches incoming Lab B email (arriving 4 days later) with original Lab A ticket.
steps.routing_rationale: Cross-run entity resolution across separate email threads.

steps.name: Dual-Failure Parameter Comparison
steps.desc: Compares chemical parameter variances between Lab A and Lab B reports.
steps.routing_rationale: Absolute precision required for hard rejection decisions (#1 TAU Banking score).

steps.name: Execute Hard Rejection & Block Lot
steps.desc: Locks lot in ERP system, prevents warehouse release, and notifies compliance.
steps.routing_rationale: Deterministic ERP lock API execution.

workflow_proactive_lab_comms.name: 5. Aviva UC5: Proactive Lab Comms (Agentic)
workflow_proactive_lab_comms.description: Autonomous Communication Agent. Tracks per-lab SLAs (Brighton = 5d, Eurofins = 7d), schedules dynamic follow-up emails 2 days prior to ETA, parses unstructured lab replies, and updates revised ETAs.
workflow_proactive_lab_comms.verdict: Requires Autonomous Agent. Dynamic schedule calculation, unstructured email reply parsing, and natural conversation loops require agentic intelligence.

steps.name: SLA & ETA Calculation
steps.desc: Computes expected turnaround times per lab vendor and schedules outreach.
steps.routing_rationale: Dynamic schedule planning based on historical lab turnaround times.

steps.name: Consolidated Outreach Dispatch
steps.desc: Gathers all pending samples for a single lab into one professional status query email.
steps.routing_rationale: Fast email generation and batching.

steps.name: Parse Unstructured Lab Reply
steps.desc: Extracts revised completion dates and bottleneck reasons from human lab manager emails.
steps.routing_rationale: Unstructured conversational understanding and date/entity extraction.

steps.name: Update ETA Tracker & Escalate
steps.desc: Updates revised ETAs in master dashboard; triggers alert if lab is unresponsive.
steps.routing_rationale: Database state update & alert dispatch.
